evidence_quotes.O: After doing some research, and reading a number of glowing reviews at different reputable photo related forums, I decided to take a chance.
evidence_quotes.C: In my informal comparison of the transfer rate of 256MB compact flash cards by Viking, SimpleTech, and Kingston, the Viking card came in a distant third.
evidence_quotes.E: informal test results for this 400x card indicate...this baby is fast!
evidence_quotes.A: For other less critical tasks, the Viking card has proven perfectly adequate.
evidence_quotes.N: It is very annoying to focus on the subject, lock on, and press the shutter button, only to have the camera fail to fire.
